description: Approved Knight-only progressive glTF example. The base file and all 89 mesh/texture LOD GLBs are local. Needle Cloud URLs are provenance, not runtime fallbacks.

permissionReview.finding: The user-supplied three.js revision uses the same two Needle Cloud URLs. Both returned HTTP 200. The Peachy Balloon GLB itself declares SKETCHFAB Standard in asset.extras.license; Mobile Home has no embedded license grant. These files are not copied. The user explicitly approved excluding both on this basis.
